groupName: More European places for one league
groupDescription: The league you choose gets far more European places: its champion always plays in the Champions League, its cup winner always in the Cup Winners' Cup, and it gets three UEFA Cup places when you manage there - about two a season when you manage elsewhere. The places come from the countries that have the most. The first season is drawn from fixed line-ups inside the game, so the league's strongest clubs are put into those as well.
name: More European places: Serbia
